prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished complete portrait mobile game daily login reward popup concept, concept 5 "Hero Ngày hôm nay + dải ngày nhỏ". Canvas approximately 886x1920, matching 390x845 logical mobile aspect ratio. Edge-to-edge screen UI, no phone device mockup. Use the supplied image as STYLE AND ICON reference: warm cream/beige Soft Miniature, rounded soft bevels, subtle shadows, shiny sculpted toy-like 3D ticket/gem/gift icons, dark navy bold rounded highly legible Vietnamese type, bright cyan header with glossy red gift box and yellow bow at left, red rounded X close button at right, orange bottom claim button. Faint dimmed racing game background only at outer edges.

Layout from top to bottom, everything fits on one screen with balanced compact spacing:
1. Cyan rounded header with gift icon, exact title "QUÀ HẰNG NGÀY", white "X" close button.
2. Exact subtitle "Đăng nhập mỗi ngày, nhận quà cực chất!" then centered small blue pill "Đã nhận: 0 ngày".
3. A single large wide golden hero reward card for TODAY. Exact labels "Ngày 1" and golden badge "HÔM NAY". Very large centered glossy blue Pro racing ticket icon recognizable from reference, with only quantity "2" underneath. Warm golden glow. Make this the visual focal point, compact but clearly larger than the upcoming days.
4. Directly below hero, ONE HORIZONTAL STRIP OF EXACTLY FIVE compact cards, all identical dimensions and evenly spaced. Each card contains its day title at top, centered icon, then its quantity only. Left to right: "Ngày 2" + blue Standard wrench ticket icon + "2"; "Ngày 3" + magenta diamond gem icon + "15"; "Ngày 4" + purple gold-edged All-Star ticket icon + "1"; "Ngày 5" + gold Elite ticket icon + "1"; "Ngày 6" + magenta diamond gem icon + "20". Five cards must be same size, centered icons, no wasted space. Day 1 deliberately larger per hero concept.
5. Full-width special day 7 cyan card with warm yellow border, title "NGÀY 7 · QUÀ ĐẶC BIỆT", glossy gift box left, magenta gem icon with only "30" and purple All-Star ticket icon with only "2" beside it. Generous readable icons and clear hierarchy.
6. Cream accumulation section exact heading "QUÀ TÍCH LŨY", a right-aligned blue pill "0/10 ngày". A thin empty progression track with four neutral circular milestones, below it four evenly spaced columns: "Ngày 10" with gem icon and "40"; "Ngày 20" with purple All-Star ticket and "2"; "Ngày 30" with gem and purple ticket icons and quantities "80 + 2"; "Ngày 40" with gem icon and "40". Compact readable balanced composition.
7. Large full-width glossy orange rounded bottom button, small shiny gift box icon and exact white label "NHẬN QUÀ".

MANDATORY text constraints: All reward values appear only as bare numbers beneath or next to their icons. Never write reward names anywhere: no "gem", no "vé", no "Pro", no "Standard", no "All-Star", no "Elite" text. Preserve all day labels. Render Vietnamese accents accurately. Do not show any "Hoàn thành 7 ngày để nhận" bar or text, no extra explanatory strip under day 7. Do not duplicate cards. No watermarks. This is a premium cohesive game UI concept, not a wireframe. Keep the reference's colorful glossy miniature icons, cyan gift header, cream body and orange claim button while completely reorganizing the daily cards into hero plus five-small-card strip.
